neighbours.label: Presenting STEM disciplines as a connected domain of education, skills, or careers
fire: The scholarship helps rural students prepare for careers in science, technology, engineering, and math.
Our mentoring network encourages young women to enter STEM fields after graduation.
The academy develops students' math and science skills through collaborative engineering projects.
Local employers want graduates with strong foundations across science, engineering, and mathematics.
The museum's STEM program connects classroom learning with opportunities in technical professions.
Her research examines why students lose interest in Science and Mathematics during secondary school.
The summer initiative introduces teenagers to physics, robotics, and engineering through university workshops.
Community colleges are building pathways into STEM careers for adults returning to education.
quiet: The scholarship helps rural students prepare for careers in history, literature, and the performing arts.
Our mentoring network encourages young women to enter political science programs after graduation.
During math class, the students calculated how much change each customer should receive.
Local employers want graduates who can write clear reports and communicate effectively with customers.
The museum's science exhibit explains how sediment accumulates at the bottom of a lake.
Her research examines why students lose interest in medieval literature during secondary school.
The summer workshop teaches experienced mechanics how to repair a particular engine model.
The college editor requested that the acronym STEM appear in bold throughout the brochure.
